notes.title: New Game and Small Update for Launch Players
notes.content:
This is a pretty small update. People who bought the game at launch *should* now have all world types unlocked. Please let us know if this is not working if you purchased the game at launch. Sorry that this announced update took so long, we have been very busy working on the next title, Five Likes Please. This is a first-person, multiplayer shooter. We are planning on releasing the game for free, but with potential campaign DLC and in-app purchases for cosmetics. Check it out, and be sure to wishlist it: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709320/Five_Likes_Please]Five Likes Please[/url]

notes.title: Version R2.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
- Changed many turret stats to balance them.

- Switched the roles of the tesla and poison turret.

- Reworked the progression function of enemy health to an exponential function.

- Added 3 difficulties:
     - Easy
     - Medium
     - Hard

- Added a new currency called "Wave Points" denoted by a teal triangle.

- Wave points are earned each wave and at the end of the game (wave 35).

- Added several new world types to be unlocked with Wave Points:
     - Islands
     - Swamp
     - Winter
     - Corrupted Forest
     - Volcano

- Added consumable items:
     - Orbital Strike
     - Lightning Strike
     - Airstrike
     - Nuke

- Some small bugfixes

- Updated the news menu.

- Updated the credits menu for new contributors.
